description:
## Problem
`scripts/check_duplicate_code.py` on develop f1c6343bbf reports two duplicate groups (26 of 1920 duplicated lines) between the two GCP adapters:
- `_upload_to_gcs(gcs_path, content)`: `benchbox/platforms/gcp/dataproc_adapter.py:368-377` and `dataproc_serverless_adapter.py:261-270`, byte-identical: strip `gs://`, split bucket and blob, `upload_from_string`.
- `_retrieve_results(job_id | batch_id)`: `dataproc_adapter.py:379-394` and `dataproc_serverless_adapter.py:272-287`, identical apart from the parameter name: list blobs under `{gcs_prefix}/results/<id>/` and parse every `.json` blob as JSON lines.
A fix to one (for example a `gs://` parsing or encoding bug) can miss the other. Both predate the run-timeout work; they surfaced while reducing duplication for #4507.

## Prior art
- `benchbox/platforms/gcp/_gcs_path.py` (`parse_gcs_staging_dir`, `GcsStagingPath`) is already shared GCS code imported by both adapters: extend it with, for example, `upload_gcs_text(client, gcs_path, content)` and `read_gcs_json_lines(client, bucket, prefix)` (names are suggestions).
- `benchbox/platforms/base/cloud_spark/staging.py` `GCSStaging` uploads local files and lists blob names through its own `storage.Client()` (no project). It has no string-upload or blob-read method, and the adapters' `_staging` can be None. It does not fit without widening the `CloudSparkStaging` contract (six subclasses).
- #4507 shared the Livy session wait the same way (`LivyStatementMixin` in `benchbox/platforms/azure/_livy_mixin.py`).

## Change
Move the two helper bodies into `_gcs_path.py`, taking the storage client, bucket and prefix as arguments. Keep `_upload_to_gcs` and `_retrieve_results` as one-line adapter methods that pass `self._get_storage_client()` (and `self.gcs_bucket` and `f"{self.gcs_prefix}/results/<id>/"`) to the shared helper: six test files patch these methods (`tests/unit/platforms/gcp/test_dataproc_coverage.py`, `test_dataproc_serverless_paths.py`, `test_dataproc_serverless_coverage.py`, `tests/unit/platforms/test_run_timeout_remote_cleanup.py`, `test_run_timeout_remote_cleanup_more_adapters.py`, `test_spark_family_timing.py`); do not change their patch targets or assertions.

Non-goals: `_get_storage_client` (byte-identical but 4 lines; each adapter's client factory and test seam) and `get_target_dialect` stay where they are; the S3 analogues (`emr_serverless_adapter.py` `_retrieve_results`, `glue_adapter.py`, `quanton_adapter.py` `_retrieve_results_from_s3`) use another SDK and are out of scope; `download_as_string` -> `download_as_bytes` is a separate change.

## Decision gates
- Behaviour-preserving refactor only: same blob names, same parsing (JSON lines, blank lines skipped, only `.json` blobs), `download_as_string` kept, same `ValueError` on a bucket-only path. Any behaviour change: STOP and record it rather than bundle it.
- The shared helpers receive the storage client as an argument and import nothing from `google.cloud`. Each adapter keeps its existing module-level optional import and `_get_storage_client` (`storage.Client(project=self.project_id)`) unchanged.
- If an implementer still prefers `GCSStaging`, STOP and record why; do not change its client construction.
- Do not add or extend `ignore_function_names` / `ignore_rules` in pyproject.toml to clear these groups; the groups must disappear because the code is shared.

## Verification rubric
Pass: `make duplicate-check-delta` prints PASS with delta -26 (or lower) vs its merge base (1920 -> 1894 on f1c6343bbf); in the output of `DUPLICATE_CHECK_FORMAT=json make duplicate-check`, no group contains a function whose file is under `benchbox/platforms/gcp/`; a new unit test of the shared helpers covers `gs://` and bare paths, a `.json` blob with blank lines, and an ignored non-`.json` blob; the six test files above pass with unchanged assertions; `make lint-imports`, `make platform-manifest-check` and `make pr-preflight` exit 0.
Fail: any behaviour change, a `google.cloud` import in the shared helpers, a remaining GCP duplicate group, or a pyproject duplicate-check ignore entry covering `_upload_to_gcs` or `_retrieve_results`.

## Guardrails
Work in a linked worktree (`make worktree-create`), never the primary clone. Edit files with the edit tool, never by script. Heavy work (benchmarks, test tiers, UAT, generators at scale) only through `make heavy-run` or lock-taking entry points; never skip the lock, admission or watchdog; never delete anything under `~/Developer/benchmark_runs`. No live cloud run and no cloud credentials unless this item's Decision gates say the owner approved it in the current task. BenchBox imposes no default run limit: add none. No comments or docstrings in first-party code; one changelog fragment for a user-facing change. Never post a stand-in review, close and reopen a pull request to restart CI, use `--no-verify`, force-push, or rewrite an author. Arm once; a second time only after fixing the cause the refusal named. Reply on every review thread; resolve it only after the bot's review of the new head does not raise it again.
